Base URL: https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/business_insights/get_marketing_hot_listing

import requests
import json

url = "https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/business_insights/get_marketing_hot_listing?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp"

payload=json.dumps({
  "end_time": 0,
  "period": "real_time/yesterday/past7days/past30days/monthday/week/",
  "product_id_list": "-",
  "start_time": 0
})
headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
response = requests.RPCRequest("POST",url,headers=headers, data=payload, allow_redirects=False)

print(response.text)
